items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 20 September 2026 9:00pm
items.description:
##Today##

Some patchy light rain or drizzle at first, then mainly fair with variable amounts of cloud. Risk of mist patches in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2 at first


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, decreasing 10-15 in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, occasionally moderate or poor in precipitation at first or any mist. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Bright or sunny intervals, especially in the north, ongoing risk of mist patches until later. Occasional rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5 overnight


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 5-15, veering NW 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist and rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Wednesday, 23 September 2026##

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

NW 15-20, increasing 20-25 for a time, then decreasing 10-15 in the evening. Becoming variable 10 or less for a time before settling S later.


##Visibility##

Mainly good. Isolated hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds for a time.


##Thursday, 24 September 2026##

Dry and bright with sunny spells.
